parameterSet.name: Planck 2018 base-LCDM, TT,TE,EE+lowE+lensing+BAO
parameterSet.table: Planck 2018 results VI (A&A 641, A6) Table 2, last column
parameterSet.model: spatially flat LCDM, Neff=3.046, one massive neutrino (0.06 eV)

omegaK.note: assumed exactly flat in the base model

TcmbK.note: Fixsen 2009 (ApJ 707, 916): 2.72548 ± 0.00057 K; commonly quoted/used by Planck as 2.7255 K

raDeg.note: ICRS, converted from (l,b) with the Hipparcos matrix; the hot lobe of the dipole

solarVelocityKmS.note: velocity of the Sun w.r.t. the CMB rest frame, toward (l,b) above

derived.method: Flat LCDM, Omega_r from T_CMB=2.7255 K and Neff=3.046 (massless-equivalent), Omega_Lambda=1-Omega_m-Omega_r; Simpson integration (scripts/data/galactic/cosmo-math.mjs). Comoving distances at z=0.

uncertainty.note: r*/theta* quadrature propagation (published r*, 100theta_MC errors; correlation ignored)

comovingDistanceToLastScatteringMpc.note: uncertainty from r*/theta* quadrature (144.57±0.22 Mpc, 100theta_MC 1.04101±0.00029); r*/theta* = 13887 Mpc cross-check

uncertainty.note: CONSERVATIVE upper bound (reproduces age sigma 0.047 vs published 0.020 Gyr): Gaussian draws of H0 and the physical density omega_m h^2 (Omega_m = omega_m h^2/h^2, which respects the Omega_m-h degeneracy), n=400; residual correlations ignored
